# 5 Relay.app Alternatives in 2026: Rebuild After Shutdown

Written by Denis Kildishev Denis Kildishev

  5 Relay.app Alternatives in 2026: Rebuild After Shutdown 

Relay.app has shut down. Its official notice says accounts, workflows, and run history were permanently deleted in September 2026, so this is a recovery and rebuilding decision—not a normal in-app migration.

Quick answer: Zapier is worth evaluating for broad app-to-app automation. Make is worth evaluating for visual branching and data transformation. n8n is worth evaluating for technical workflow automation with hosting choice. [...] Make: Official demo: a visual scenario connecting Google Sheets and OpenAI.

Official demo: a visual scenario connecting Google Sheets and OpenAI. Official source. Reused from the existing workflow article asset library; original capture date was not recorded.

Why consider it: Consider Make if your reason for leaving Relay.app centers on visual branching and data transformation. Rebuild a branching workflow and inspect credits, retries, and the output of each branch.

Trade-off: A large scenario still needs documentation and an owner. Loops, polling, and repeated actions can change usage substantially.

Pricing: Free and paid credit-based plans; modules and specialized actions have documented charging rules. Check current pricing and plan details. [...] ## 1. Zapier: best for broad app-to-app automation

Connect business applications through workflows so events in one system can trigger actions in another. It suits teams that prefer a managed integration platform and documented connectors.

Zapier: Support-ticket automation shown in the Zapier workflow editor.

Why consider it: Consider Zapier if your reason for leaving Relay.app centers on broad app-to-app automation. Run an intake-to-CRM workflow and inspect duplicate handling, failed actions, and task usage.
